name: Rock im Park
description: Twin festival of Rock am Ring at Nuremberg Zeppelinfeld
price: weekend + camping 258/288 EUR sold out; limited day tickets
details: Rock am Ring's twin festival with the same line-up in a different day order. More than 50,000 weekend tickets were sold by 22 Sep 2026; a limited number of day tickets are on sale. Headliners: blink-182 (Sun), Bring Me The Horizon (Sat), Die Toten Hosen, Turnstile, Faith No More, Parkway Drive. The Prodigy are very special guest on Sunday.
note: THE PRODIGY (Sun) + BRING ME THE HORIZON (Sat); day tickets
